name: Cuauhtémoc
role: Eleventh and final Tlatoani of Tenochtitlan
contribution: The Aztec ruler of Tenochtitlan from 1520 to 1521, and the last Aztec Emperor.

checks.lead: Cuauhtémoc (Nahuatl pronunciation: [kʷaːʍˈtemoːk] , Spanish pronunciation: [kwawˈtemok] ), also known as Cuauhtemotzín, Guatimozín, or Guatémoc, was the Aztec ruler (tlatoani) of Tenochtitlan from 1520 to 1521, and the last Aztec Emperor.  The name Cuauhtemōc means "one who has descended like an eagle", commonly rendered in English as "Descending Eagle", evoking a raptor diving toward its prey.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
